subject: Acme Financial — Onsite Workshop: travel, rooms, and timezone coverage
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@acme-fin.com>, Emily Chen <echen@acme-fin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Oct 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: Onsite workshop Nov 12-14 (logistics and timezone coverage)

Sanjay / Emily —

Thanks again for confirming the workshop dates (Nov 12–14). A few logistics items we want to lock down so we can finalize travel and room blocks: 

- Headcount: please confirm expected attendee list by team (approx numbers for execs, eng, product, security).
- Preferred onsite time window each day (start/end) — we know you have APAC regional stakeholders joining remotely on Day 2.
- Hotel proximity preference and whether Acme will handle travel bookings or want Redwood to manage group rates.

We have a tentative agenda and a hotel-block suggestion attached (Acme-Workshop-Agenda-v3.pdf, Hotel-Block-Details.xlsx). Can you confirm by EOD Friday so we can book flights and submit calendar holds?

Best,
Jordan
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Acme-Workshop-Agenda-v3.pdf]

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@acme-fin.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Emily Chen <echen@acme-fin.com>
Cc: Rajiv Khanna <r.khanna@acme-fin.com>, Acme Facilities <facilities@acme-fin.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Oct 2025 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: Onsite workshop Nov 12-14 (logistics and timezone coverage)

Jordan —

Quick answers below:
- Headcount: 18 onsite (2 execs, 8 product/eng, 4 IT/security, 4 operations). I will email a roster by Monday.
- Day windows: Day 1: 9:00–17:00; Day 2: 8:30–15:00 (APAC call 20:00–22:00 PT); Day 3: 9:00–13:00.
- Travel: Acme will handle exec travel; please coordinate group rates/hotel block for the rest. Facilities can confirm room and A/V needs.

I'll loop Facilities on preferred rooms and capacity. Thanks for the agenda — looks good.

—Sanjay
Head of Data Platforms
Acme Financial

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@acme-fin.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Oct 2025 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: Onsite workshop Nov 12-14 (logistics and timezone coverage)

Jordan / team —

I started booking the hotel block (attached). Key decisions:
- Block: 15 rooms reserved at Grand Harbor Hotel (walking distance) Nov 11–15 to cover early arrivals and late departures.
- Rate: $229/night (inc. basic wifi). Cutoff: Oct 28.
- Meeting room: Harbor Ballroom (60p) with theater + breakouts; A/V included.

Action items for us:
1) Do we want to set up a dedicated APAC bridge for Day 2 or rely on Zoom + local projector? I recommend a dedicated bridge with a local AV tech.
2) Confirm attendee roster so we can release extras after cutoff.

Attaching Hotel-Block-Details.xlsx and the calendar hold (Calendar-Hold-Nov12-14.ics). I'll send an internal booking tracker to Dev for flight coordination.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Program Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Hotel-Block-Details.xlsx]
[Attachment: Calendar-Hold-Nov12-14.ics]

Date: Tue, 28 Oct 2025 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Onsite workshop Nov 12-14 (logistics and timezone coverage)

Thanks Marissa — this looks good. A couple of notes from the travel side:
- I'll create a shared spreadsheet for flight itineraries and preferred seat/loyalty info.
- For APAC bridge: recommend we pre-book an AV tech for Nov 12 evening PT (their Day 2), and test on Nov 11 afternoon PT to avoid last-minute issues.
- Remote attendee kit: I can ship a small kit (HD webcam + mic) to the conference room if Facilities allows. Cost estimate attached.

I'll start populating the booking tracker and tag people for approvals.

–Dev
Program Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: AV-Quote-Nov12.pdf]

Date: Fri, 31 Oct 2025 11:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: Onsite workshop Nov 12-14 (logistics and timezone coverage)

Jordan / team —

Roster attached (final for now). A couple clarifications from Facilities:
- Catering windows are 12:00–13:00 (lunch) and 15:00–15:30 (break). Please confirm dietary restrictions by Nov 5.
- They prefer the AV tech option; Acme will cover the vendor fee.
- Execs will arrive Nov 11 evening; they'll take care of their own rooms.

I added Rajiv for final sign-off on the room layout. Please proceed with bookings and send calendar invites for the finalized timeslots.

Thanks,
Emily

Acme Financial

Subject: Re: Draft: Onsite workshop Nov 12-14 (logistics and timezone coverage) — final confirmations and calendar invites

Thanks everyone — final confirmations below and next steps: 

- Agenda locked (see Drive link).
- Hotel block confirmed for Redwood attendees; cutoff passed but Facilities said they can extend to cover late additions (Marissa will confirm changes).
- AV tech pre-booked for Nov 11 test and Nov 12 evening (APAC bridge).
- Catering windows noted; please collect dietary restrictions by Nov 5.
- Calendar invites and room bookings: sent to Acme room schedule and Redwood team; internal calendar hold shows locations and dial-in.

Next steps for Redwood ops: Dev to finalize flight list and tracker by Nov 5; Tessa to confirm equipment shipping and on-site check-in flow. Sanjay/Emily to confirm any last-minute exec travel details.

I'll attach the final calendar file in a separate email to ensure the invite shows up correctly. Looking forward to an efficient workshop.

Best,
Jordan
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
